speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song
text: asked the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Trade and Industry (a) whether the Ministry has assessed the impact of a major e-commerce platform’s recent extension of payment terms on small businesses in Singapore; and (b) whether regulations can be applied to ensure that large e-commerce platforms release payments promptly to support small merchants and prevent undue delays in cash flow.

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: Could the Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI) lean more on these large e-commerce platforms to enforce fairer prompt payment terms, specifically for smaller merchants, so as to ease their cash flow challenges?

speaker: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song (Aljunied)
text: These small merchants have limited negotiating power and lack the financial resources and access to financing of larger firms.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: As I mentioned earlier on, the changes to the payment terms between the e-commerce platform and their merchants are commercial arrangements.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: However, MTI and Enterprise Singapore had gone the extra mile.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: We, in fact, contacted the feedback provider and thanked him for the feedback.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: We shared that Enterprise Singapore had, in fact, contacted the platform.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: We responded also to the feedback provider on the two issues that he had raised and also provided a point of contact to the platform provider.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: We also shared the feedback provider's feedback and suggestions to the platform.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: On his questions about how to better support small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and also merchants, there are a few ways.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: One, let me just be quite specific, it is not just specific to this platform but, for example, we collaborated with this platform and, in fact, others, with our Enterprise Singapore teams, on initiatives to uplift the overall ecosystem.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: Number two, we had programmes to help our SMEs internationalise and also to help them to kickstart their e-commerce journey.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: [Pursuant to Standing Order No 22(3), provided that Members had not asked for questions standing in their names to be postponed to a later Sitting day or withdrawn, written answers to questions not reached by the end of Question Time are reproduced in the Appendix.]
